items.title: KKR (KKR) Bets On Data Centres, Home Services And Healthcare With New Deals
items.summary: KKR (NYSE:KKR) is ramping up activity in digital infrastructure, home services and healthcare with a series of new deals. The firm agreed to acquire a majority stake in global data centre operator ST Telemedia Global Data Centres in recent days. KKR also entered a definitive agreement for a minority investment in Malaysian provider Avisena Healthcare.
